title: Dashboard Clarity
changes: Redesigned the front dashboard around three questions: what to do next, how Japanese is progressing, and what needs attention.
Combined Journey topic, Sensei guidance, mission composition and Continue/Reviews into one Today's Learning card.
Removed the eight-card dashboard stats grid and replaced it with a capability chart for Recognising, Recall and Usable vocabulary.
Simplified Study Modes to a Journey / Japan Ready switch without permanent explanatory copy.
Replaced duplicated dashboard shortcuts with four clear destinations: Practice, Collection, Progress and Community.
Moved Invite out of the front dashboard; it remains available from Community.
Made streak text actionable by showing how many answers remain to protect today's streak.
Removed generic hero text and permanent avatar milestone copy from the dashboard.
Renamed Activity Village wording to Practice Activities where it remains visible.
Retains all v11.4 Adaptive Learning, Campfire Recall, Kotoba Rain and Kotoba Colosseum functionality.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.5.0.
